name: Data Engineering
goal: The entry track for whoever builds the infrastructure behind decisions: modelling, the warehouse, pipelines and the cloud the data lives in. It ends where a junior data engineer is hired — the platform at scale, streaming, governance and MLOps continue in Data Platform. Sequence based on the community Data Engineer roadmap at roadmap.sh, which recommends Python and SQL as prerequisites. Most of the courses come from earlier tracks.

courses.choice: the cloud the data lives in
courses.note: The engineering up to here is the same anywhere. What changes is the managed service you are given: the warehouse, the stream and the orchestrator each have a different name and a different bill on each provider.
